title.narrative: Sustainable Electric Transportation for Nepal (SET 4 Nepal)

description.narrative: Widespread adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) has been recognized by the Government of Nepal as a priority for the transport sector. The project aims to systematically remove barriers holding back the electrifications of the transport sector. The project will deliver a blend of financial mechanisms and technical assistance with a focus on the minibus segment in the Kathmandu Valley and beyond. The project will support public transport operators to finance and deploy 3,500 electric minibuses (EMB) and charging stations nationally, and to promote and strengthen widespread adoption of EVs through reforms to policy, regulation and permitting and improved capacity. As a result of the project, a projected 85% of all new minibuses purchased in Nepal will be electric by 2030. The project will directly leverage EUR 299 million for e-mobility and directly mitigate 1.78 million tons CO2e over the lifetime of the vehicles.
